title: Senior Software Developer (C++)
description:
Senior Software Developer
About Windcave:
Founded in 1999 in New Zealand, Windcave has consistently led the way in the innovation of payment technology. Today, our global footprint extends across 40+ countries, supported by a dedicated team of over 400+ experts. We process billions of transactions annually, providing businesses with a comprehensive payment solution through a single
provider.
Our approach continuously sets new industry benchmarks and reflects our commitment to leading the market with self-developed, cutting-edge technologies. We support a wide range of industries, including retail, finance, hospitality, and more, with operations all over the globe.
Our Sydney office is seeking a talented Senior Software Developer to join the team.
Windcave developers deliver:
24/7 high performing, fault tolerant, scalable server designs
Highly usable and fast web front ends and APIs
World class data and web security
To join the team you will need to demonstrate:
Proven expertise (5+ years) in programming C++
Ideally experience with one or more of the following:
Databases / SQL
Web / Internet Technologies
Distributed Systems.
Benefits on offer:
We value our employees and offer competitive benefits, including:
·        Competitive salary
·        Hybrid work (currently following hybrid work model; mandatory 3 days’ work from office Monday, Tuesday, and Friday)
·        Flexible working hours
·        Career development and long-term career opportunity
·        Discounted health insurance (depending upon eligibility)
·        Diverse, energetic and friendly team environment
Why join us?
At Windcave, you will have the opportunity to grow, develop, and be part of a company that values your contributions. We are committed to providing:
·        A supportive and inclusive environment
·        Career development and learning opportunities
·        Exciting and challenging projects
·        On going training and support
If you are passionate about payment industry, eager to make an impact and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of something great!
Windcave is an Equal Opportunity Employer and committed to building a diverse workforce.

application.coverLetter:

The primary reason is a critical mismatch between the job's core requirement and the candidate's documented skills. The job description mandates **"Proven expertise (5+ years) in programming C++,"** which is a programming language not listed anywhere in the candidate's resume. The candidate's experience is primarily in **Python and JavaScript**.

While the candidate has relevant experience in other areas mentioned in the job description, such as distributed systems (microservices), databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), web technologies (REST APIs, React), and a 5+ year background in software engineering, the absence of C++ expertise is a fundamental disqualification for this specific role. A cover letter cannot credibly highlight a required skill that the candidate does not possess.

Therefore, the documents do not contain the necessary information to craft a suitable application for this position.

JOHN DOE
Software Engineer
Email: john.doe@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/johndoe | GitHub: github.com/johndoe

SUMMARY
Experienced Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience developing scalable web applications and distributed systems. Proficient in Python, JavaScript, and cloud technologies. Strong background in REST APIs, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer | TechCorp Inc. | San Francisco, CA | 2021 - Present
• Developed and maintained microservices architecture serving 1M+ daily users
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker, reducing deployment time by 60%
• Led a team of 3 junior developers and mentored new hires
• Technologies: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

Software Engineer | StartupXYZ | Austin, TX | 2019 - 2021
• Built REST APIs for mobile and web applications using Python and Django
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver features on tight deadlines
• Optimized database queries improving application performance by 40%
• Technologies: Python, Django, MySQL, Redis, Git

Junior Developer | DevShop LLC | Austin, TX | 2018 - 2019
• Developed frontend components using React and JavaScript
• Participated in code reviews and followed agile development practices
• Fixed bugs and implemented small features under senior guidance
• Technologies: JavaScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Texas at Austin | 2018
GPA: 3.8/4.0
Relevant Coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Database Systems, Software Engineering

SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, Go
Frameworks: Django, Flask, React, Node.js
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git
Other: REST APIs, Microservices, Agile Development, Testing

CERTIFICATIONS
• AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2022)
• Docker Certified Associate (2021)

PROJECTS
E-commerce Platform | Personal Project | 2020
• Built a full-stack e-commerce application using Python/Django and React
• Implemented payment processing with Stripe API
• Deployed on AWS using Docker containers
• GitHub: github.com/johndoe/ecommerce-platform

title: Full Stack JavaScript Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer | 6 Month Contract | $900/day
Sydney | Hybrid (2 days in office)
We're working with one of Sydney's most forward-thinking digital teams who are building a suite of modern, data-driven web applications used by thousands of customers every day. They're now looking for a
true
Full Stack Engineer, someone equally confident crafting slick front-end experiences in React as they are building scalable back-end services in Node.js.
This is a hands-on role within a high-performing engineering squad that values clean code, autonomy, and solving complex problems the right way.
What you'll be doing
Designing and developing full-stack features across React and Node.js.
Building clean, reusable UI components and well-structured APIs.
Working closely with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines and automate deployments.
Contributing to architectural decisions and helping shape technical direction.
Collaborating with product and design teams to deliver an exceptional user experience.
Tech environment
React, Node.js, TypeScript, Express, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS (Lambda, ECS), CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Jenkins), Terraform.
What's in it for you
$900/day contract with likely extensions.
2 days in a stunning Sydney office (great team culture, genuinely flexible).
Work with talented engineers solving interesting, large-scale problems.
Mix of Greenfield feature builds and plenty of architectural input.
Join a team that values innovation, engineering excellence, and balance.
If you love working across the full stack, enjoy ownership, and want to build meaningful software in a modern tech environment, this is worth a look.
Apply now or reach out for a confidential chat.

application.coverLetter:
Based on the provided documents, here is a compelling and professional cover letter tailored to the job posting.

***

**Subject: Application for Full Stack Engineer Contract Role**

Dear SustainRecruit Team,

I am writing with great enthusiasm to express my interest in the Full Stack Engineer contract position you are advertising, which I discovered on Seek. With over five years of experience developing scalable web applications and a proven track record across both front-end and back-end technologies, I am confident I possess the skills and drive to make an immediate impact on your client's high-performing engineering squad.
